title: Understanding the Scatter Plot
text: The scatter plot shows a negative correlation between age and mpg. As age increases, mpg decreases.

title: Analyzing Plot (a)
text: Plot (a) is a KDE plot with multiple peaks. Consider which variable might have such a distribution.

title: Analyzing Plot (b)
text: Plot (b) is a KDE plot with a single peak. Think about which variable might have a more uniform distribution.

title: Analyzing Plot (c)
text: Plot (c) is a histogram with a uniform distribution. Consider which variable might be evenly distributed.

title: Analyzing Plot (d)
text: Plot (d) is a histogram with a skewed distribution. Think about which variable might have this kind of distribution.

title: Analyzing Plot (e.i) and (e.ii)
text: These are point plots showing means and confidence intervals. Consider the relationship between age and mpg.

title: Analyzing Plot (f.i) and (f.ii)
text: These are point plots similar to (e.i) and (e.ii). Think about the correlation between the variables.

title: Analyzing Plot (g.i) and (g.ii)
text: These are scatter plots. Compare them with the labeled scatter plot to determine consistency.

title: Analyzing Plot (h.i) and (h.ii)
text: These plots show a perfect linear relationship. Consider if such a relationship exists between age and mpg.
